title: Vacate user with company membership — DRAFT 0.5 (2026-10-27)
description: Private full-record schema, not an OIDC token or a write payload. Account fields are flat; company data is under a single membership. Defaults are annotations: backend must normalize create inputs before validation. Missing fields on PATCH do not reset existing values. Self-editing is limited to firstName, middleName, lastName, gender, married, dependentChildren and soleCare. Membership configuration requires target-company admin authority; derived balances remain server-owned. Authorization is enforced by server update contracts, not this schema. Public API routes and relationship references use GUIDs. Domain/storage entities have numeric Id and separate Guid; API projections resolve numeric foreign keys to public GUID references.

id.description: Confirmed internal positive numeric user ID, separate from public GUID.

guid.description: Stable public account identifier; not an authorization grant.

username.description: Company-email username, unique across Vacate; uniqueness is enforced by the backend/database.

gender.description: Existing fictional mock values retained provisionally; not a complete production taxonomy or proof of entitlement.

status.description: Account access status; minimal lifecycle proposal.

married.description: Unknown or omitted input is normalized to false on creation, per founder direction. Replaces maritalStatus enum.

dependentChildren.description: Dependent-child count; unknown or omitted input is normalized to zero on creation, per founder direction.

soleCare.description: Unknown or omitted input is normalized to false on creation. Cannot be true when married is true.

membership.description: Null before assignment through a target-company administrator invitation. One assigned membership at most for MVP. Invitation lifecycle/acceptance timing is not defined here.

managerUserId.description: Public GUID reference; resolved to numeric ManagerUserId in the domain/storage model.

priorService.description: Years employed before current employer, registered by employer at hiring. ASSUMPTION: fractional years allowed; precision/recognition basis remains open. Null until supplied; do not add current-employer tenure here.

membership.description: One current company membership for mock/MVP; the current company-shaped MVP maps organization to company, while generic/cross-company organizations remain deferred. System-role reference resolves to employee/admin. Job role is a separate company-scoped reference. Only target-company admins may add/update configurable membership attributes. Derived balance values are server/ledger-owned, including for admins. Assignment follows an authorized company administrator invitation; invitation/team/role references must be validated server-side. No self-assignment.

available.description: Derived allocation minus used minus pending. May be negative after corrections; cannot authorize new excess requests.

balance.description: PROPOSAL: annual period allowance and derived ledger snapshot, not an independently writable remaining-days column. Numbers in the example are synthetic, not statutory defaults. Backend must enforce cross-field equations and policy minimum.

username.description: Company-email username, unique across Vacate; uniqueness is enforced by the backend/database.

gender.description: Existing fictional mock values retained provisionally; not a complete production taxonomy or proof of entitlement.

email.description: Derived from the company-email username in the current model; not a second independently editable email.

jobTitle.description: Display title resolved from the viewed user's jobRoleId in the authorized company; single title for MVP.

systemRole.description: Display role resolved from the viewed user's membership in the authorized company; not an authorization grant.

directoryPerson.description: Founder-confirmed colleague profile allowlist, 2026-10-26. Same authorized company scope only. Never include family facts, full membership, status, employment/service details or balances. Backend must select this projection before serialization; UI hiding is insufficient.
